profile.name: Prof. Ashish Karn
profile.biography: Ashish Karn is an Associate Professor at the Centre for Traditional Indian Knowledge and Skills, IIT Bombay. His work spans engineering and Indian knowledge systems, including fluid mechanics, hydropower, biomimicry, engineering education, and the study of traditional engineering ideas. He earned his Ph.D. and M.S. in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Minnesota Twin Cities and his B.Tech. from IIT Delhi.
researchTags: Development of Engineering Ideas in Indian Tradition
Architectural Engineering: Vāstu and Śilpaśāstra Texts
profile.researchOverview: His CV also describes work in supercavitation and naval defence, active learning and engineering pedagogy, and biomimetics in engineering education.
